response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks demonstrable production-scale multi-agent AI systems in fintech, regulatory compliance experience, and leadership scaling engineering teams beyond 10 people — critical gaps for a CTO role requiring deep fintech-AI infrastructure ownership.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven ability to build and deploy event-driven, scalable systems (GISCollective, DLang microservices)
Strong engineering culture advocacy through workshops, TDD, and open-source tooling
concerns: No evidence of building or operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech environments
Lacks documented experience scaling engineering teams beyond 10–15 people or developing senior technical leadership layers
No mention of real-time credit risk, working-capital algorithms, or financial compliance infrastructure
